positions.name: PerformanceAsMigrationWarrant
positions.frame: how does quantified performance and cost evidence serve as the warrant for a database migration decision?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere around the same directional read: a technology change justified through proportional performance and cost gains. src-1 performs the assertion with 10x query performance and lower licensing cost as reasons; src-2 records the same gains as the basis of a settled decision with a timeline. Tension is present: src-1 frames the switch as present and realis ("We're switching"), while src-2 places it in a future, irrealis timeline (Q3 2026) — the frame holds both the performed commitment and the planned execution without resolving the gap.
